open_items: ESTAT: gateway metadata (list_dataflows) still failing at cycle 1447 with 'tool call list_dataflows timed out after 60.0s', after a genuine provider-side HTTP 500 outage at cycle 1446 (all paths, now recovered everywhere except this). Live recheck confirmed the full ESTAT dataflow catalog is ~38MB and takes ~31s to download alone with no other load, leaving little margin under the 60s deadline -- matches the already-known 'list_dataflows times out at 60s under load' pattern rather than new breakage. Reported in incidents.md cycle 1447. Watch the next cycle: if it clears on its own, close this; if it persists past one more cycle, escalate as a real gateway-side problem.

ILO: chronic Cloudflare/WAF-shaped 403 pattern against ILO's direct (and sometimes gateway) path. Last occurrence remains cycle 1438. /api/history shows ILO healthy continuously from cycle 1439 through the current cycle 1447 (9 clean cycles). Not re-reported. Full occurrence list through cycle 1438 (re-derive from /api/history?hours=240 when next relevant): 1320, 1323, 1327-1328, 1330, 1333, 1342-1345, 1354-1355, 1363, 1366, 1378, 1382, 1385, 1389-1390, 1392, 1414, 1438. Not a gateway code bug; nothing to fix. Keep watching for the next occurrence.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1447 (reconfirmed by /api/contracts this run). Still open, not re-reported since no new change.

encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flip: seen on ILO and OECD previously, seen again on ILO and OECD this run (cycle 1447, /api/contracts changes array, swapped relative to cycle 1444). Verdict stays ok; this is the known cosmetic flip (not endpoint-specific), not an incident.
claude/ triage branches on origin: 162 as of this run (was 161+ last run), still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

Monitor bug (standing): /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status and /api/contracts. No contract-only degraded state occurred this run to re-confirm it, but the bug itself is unfixed.

Chronic gateway bug (empty 'Error: ' message from tools/sdmx_tools.py around lines 207-209 catching Exception with an empty str(e)): previously traced on ABS (most recently cycle 1403), ESTAT (cycles 1143, 1335, 1365, 1371, 1395, 1407), ECB (cycles 1337, 1339-adjacent, 1345, 1357, 1385-1386, 1388), and IMF (cycle 1368). No new occurrence this run (cycles 1445-1447 clean of this symptom; cycle 1446's ESTAT errors were a distinct, correctly-populated 'Server error 500' message, not this empty-message bug). Still unfixed; recommend addressing the exception handler.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ECB does not support /availableconstraint/ (404 is expected, not an error); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); IMF direct json check is skipped by design (IMF ignores the JSON Accept header and returns XML); STATSNZ direct json check is skipped by design (Stats NZ ignores the JSON Accept header and returns CSV); BIS/IMF/ILO references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); encoding:structure_xml charset/version order flips cosmetically from time to time across endpoints, verdict stays ok.
